issue.title: Lazy-load bead mutation helpers from write fast paths
issue.description: Deferred by epic bead sase-en in plans:202608/bead_show_speed.md; not caused by that epic. src/sase/main/bead_fast_path.py imports close_mutation_commit_message and mutation_commit_message from sase.bead.mutation_commit at module scope, even for read-only fast-path commands such as blocked, ready, and dep list. On the integrated tree a fresh bead_fast_path import averages 137.5 ms. Scope: move mutation-only imports and transitive work behind write dispatch, preserve mutation side effects and error behavior, and add import-isolation coverage proving read fast paths avoid the mutation stack.
